// Fixed long-dialogue plan and source/provenance adapters; no provider calls.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { validateSemanticCase, sourceExcerpt, evidenceCoverage } from './semantic-evidence.mjs';
import { memoryMessages, packedMemoryMessages, literal } from '../src/memory.js';
export const semanticHost = '06bde939fb1e9c4c8d8641d810f0a916b5bce127';
export const semanticFiles = ['tests/fixtures/semantic-long-v1.json','tests/fixtures/semantic-evidence-v1.json','scripts/semantic-evidence.mjs','scripts/semantic-long.mjs','scripts/semantic-live.mjs','scripts/semantic-results.mjs','docs/semantic-long-evaluation.md'];
export const sha = bytes => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
export const loadLong = () => JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../tests/fixtures/semantic-long-v1.json', import.meta.url)));
export const sourceFiles = ['index.js','src/client.js','src/gate.js','src/memory.js','src/context.js','src/status.js','scripts/generation-smoke.mjs','scripts/generation-cleanup.mjs','scripts/provider-retry.mjs','scripts/provider-spacing.mjs',...semanticFiles];
export const sourceHashes = () => Object.fromEntries(sourceFiles.map(file=>[file,sha(readFileSync(new URL(`../${file}`,import.meta.url)))]));
export function longSchedule(fixture) {
    return Array.from({length:fixture.settings.repetitions},(_,r)=>fixture.cases.flatMap((item,i)=>( (i+r)%2 ? ['on','off']:['off','on']).map(mode=>({id:`${item.id}/r${r+1}/${mode}`,case:item.id,repetition:r+1,mode})))).flat();
}
export const hostSource = item => item.messages.map(m=>({mes:m.text,name:m.speaker,is_user:m.role==='user',is_system:false,send_date:0,extra:{}}));
export function validateLong(fixture) {
    assert.equal(fixture.version,'semantic-long-v1');
    const bytes=readFileSync(new URL('../tests/fixtures/semantic-evidence-v1.json',import.meta.url));
    assert.equal(fixture.microFixtureSha256,sha(bytes)); const micro=JSON.parse(bytes);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.settings,{context:1536,recent:8,budget:400,effectiveBudget:320,maxOutputTokens:256,repetitions:2});
    assert.equal(fixture.generation.model,'gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14'); assert.equal(fixture.generation.temperature,0);
    assert.equal(fixture.cases.length,16); assert.equal(new Set(fixture.cases.map(c=>c.id)).size,16);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.cases.map(c=>c.microCase),micro.cases.map(c=>c.id));
    for(const item of fixture.cases){
        validateSemanticCase(item); const original=micro.cases.find(c=>c.id===item.microCase);
        assert.equal(item.id,`long-${original.id}`); assert.equal(item.question,original.question);
        assert.equal(item.shape,original.shape); assert.equal(item.language,original.language);
        assert.deepEqual(item.evidence,original.evidence,'Original fact/context rubric changed');
        const renamed=s=>s.replaceAll('Lina','SillyMemory E2E Mira').replaceAll('수빈','SillyMemory E2E Mira');
        assert.deepEqual(item.expected,{type:original.expected.type,answerRule:renamed(original.expected.answerRule),forbiddenClaims:original.expected.forbiddenClaims.map(renamed)});
        assert.deepEqual(item.messages.slice(0,original.messages.length),original.messages.map(m=>({...m,speaker:m.role==='assistant'?'SillyMemory E2E Mira':m.speaker})));
        assert.equal(item.messages.length,60);
        for(const ref of item.evidence){assert(ref.message<item.messages.length+1-fixture.settings.recent);assert(!item.messages.slice(original.messages.length).some(m=>m.text.includes(ref.quote)),'Evidence leaked into padding/cues');assert(!item.question.includes(ref.quote));}
    }
    return fixture;
}
export function pinnedCounter(host) {
    assert(host,'ST_SOURCE required');
    assert.equal(execFileSync('git',['-C',host,'rev-parse','HEAD'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim(),semanticHost);
    const require=createRequire(path.resolve(host,'package.json'));
    assert.equal(JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(path.dirname(require.resolve('tiktoken')),'package.json'))).version,'1.0.22');
    const encoder=require('tiktoken').encoding_for_model('gpt-4o');
    return {count:text=>text?encoder.encode(text).length+6:0,close:()=>encoder.free()};
}
export function buildLongPlan(count) {
    const fixture=validateLong(loadLong());
    const preflight=fixture.cases.map(item=>{
        const sourceTokens=count(item.messages.map(m=>m.text).join('\n'));
        const recentTokens=count([...item.messages.slice(-(fixture.settings.recent-1)).map(m=>m.text),item.question].join('\n'));
        assert(sourceTokens>fixture.settings.context,`${item.id}: insufficient overflow`);
        assert(recentTokens+fixture.settings.effectiveBudget+150<fixture.settings.context-fixture.settings.maxOutputTokens,`${item.id}: recent history cannot fit with memory and prompt reserve`);
        return {id:item.id,sourceTokens,recentTokens,effectiveBudget:fixture.settings.effectiveBudget};
    });
    return {version:fixture.version,settings:fixture.settings,generation:fixture.generation,cases:fixture.cases,schedule:longSchedule(fixture),fixtureSha256:sha(JSON.stringify(fixture)),sourceSha256:sourceHashes(),preflight,results:null};
}
export async function verifySemanticPlan(filename) {
    assert(filename,'SM_NATURAL_PLAN must identify the frozen semantic plan');
    const bytes=readFileSync(filename),plan=JSON.parse(bytes),counter=pinnedCounter(process.env.ST_SOURCE);
    try{assert.deepEqual(plan,buildLongPlan(counter.count),'Frozen plan or current inputs changed');}finally{counter.close();}
    return {plan,sha256:sha(bytes)};
}
// Convert validated current local chunks to literal source coordinates, then
// independently verify the native role/header/text in the outgoing prompt.
export function semanticPromptEvidence(item,passages,outgoing) {
    assert(Array.isArray(passages)&&Array.isArray(outgoing));
    const memory=[];const delivered=[];
    for(const doc of passages){
        const message=item.messages[doc.message];assert(message,'Unknown selected message');
        assert.equal(doc.role,message.role);assert.equal(doc.speaker,message.speaker);
        assert(Number.isInteger(doc.chunk)&&doc.chunk>=0);
        const start=Array.from(message.text).slice(0,doc.chunk*800).join('').length,end=start+doc.text.length;
        assert.equal(message.text.slice(start,end),doc.text,'Selected source chunk changed');
        const excerpt=sourceExcerpt(item,doc.message,start,end); memory.push(excerpt);
        delivered.push(excerpt);
    }
    // Accept either complete rendering used by the runtime. Matching the full
    // grouped label verifies EVERY coordinate, not just a repeated body or a
    // coordinate substring (1:1 must not match 11:1).
    const found = [memoryMessages(passages), packedMemoryMessages(passages)].some(messages =>
        messages.every(message => outgoing.some(m => m.role === (message.is_user ? 'user' : 'assistant')
            && typeof m.content === 'string' && m.content.includes(message.mes.trim()))));
    assert(found,'Selected excerpt missing or role changed in outgoing prompt');
    // The host can preserve some native old messages even with memory disabled.
    for(const [index,message]of item.messages.entries())if(outgoing.some(m=>m.role===message.role&&typeof m.content==='string'&&m.content.includes(literal(message.text))))delivered.push(sourceExcerpt(item,index,0,message.text.length));
    return {memory:evidenceCoverage(item,memory),prompt:evidenceCoverage(item,delivered)};
}
if(process.argv[1]&&import.meta.url===pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href){
    const [output]=process.argv.slice(2);assert(output&&process.argv.length===3,'Usage: ST_SOURCE=/pinned/host node scripts/semantic-long.mjs new-plan.json');
    const counter=pinnedCounter(process.env.ST_SOURCE);let plan;try{plan=buildLongPlan(counter.count);}finally{counter.close();}
    writeFileSync(output,JSON.stringify(plan,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});console.log(JSON.stringify({output,samples:plan.schedule.length,preflight:plan.preflight}));
}
